CHANNEL_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN: Unknown capability name (allowed: chat, embeddings, images, rerank, audio)
CHANNEL_LOSS_POLICY_INVALID: Loss policy must be allow, safe or strict
CHANNEL_MODELS_EMPTY: The channel has no model list; specify a model to probe
CHANNEL_NO_AVAILABLE_KEY: The channel has no usable key
GROUP_CODE_ALREADY_EXISTS: A billing group with this code already exists
GROUP_CODE_IMMUTABLE: Group code cannot be changed; create a new group and migrate the references
GROUP_CODE_INVALID_FORMAT: Group code may contain only letters, digits, '_' and '-'
GROUP_CODE_TOO_LONG: Group code must be at most 64 characters
GROUP_CODE_UNKNOWN: No live billing group with this code; an override pointing to it would fail every request of that user
GROUP_IN_USE_BY_CHANNEL: The group is still listed by channels; remove it from their groups first
GROUP_IN_USE_BY_OVERRIDE: The group is still used by per-user overrides; remove them first
GROUP_IN_USE_BY_TOKEN: The group is still used as a token group override; move those tokens first
GROUP_OVERRIDE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This user already has a billing override; edit it instead
GROUP_OVERRIDE_NOT_FOUND: No per-user billing override for this user
MEMBER_GROUP_ALREADY_MAPPED: This member group is already mapped to another billing group
MEMBER_NOT_CHARGEABLE: No chargeable member with this userId: the id may be mistyped, or the member is disabled or closed
MOCK_RECHARGE_DISABLED: Mock recharge is disabled (set NEWGATE_ENABLE_MOCK_RECHARGE=true in a test environment)
PRICE_INVALID: Price must be a non-negative decimal (at most 7 integer digits)
QUOTA_GRANT_AMOUNT_INVALID: Grant amount must be positive; use revoke to reduce quota
QUOTA_REVOKE_AMOUNT_INVALID: Revoke amount must be positive (a non-positive revoke is a grant)
QUOTA_REVOKE_REF_REQUIRED: Revoke requires a ref as idempotency key (e.g. revoke:TICKET_ID)
REDEMPTION_CODE_DISABLED: The redemption code has been disabled
REDEMPTION_CODE_USED: The redemption code has already been used
REDEMPTION_EXPIRES_AT_INVALID: Expiry time must be in the future
REDEMPTION_NOTE_TOO_LONG: Note must be at most 255 characters
REMARK_TOO_LONG: Remark must be at most 256 characters
SALE_OVERRIDE_INVALID: Sale override must be a JSON object
SALE_PER_REQUEST_INVALID: Per-request sale price must be a non-negative integer or null
SALE_PRICE_BELOW_COST_FLOOR: Sale price is below the cost floor (official cost × minimum margin)
TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT_INVALID: Expiry time must be in the future
UPSTREAM_URL_PRIVATE_ADDRESS: The URL points to a loopback, private or link-local address (set NEWGATE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_UPSTREAM=true to allow private upstreams)
UPSTREAM_URL_SCHEME_INVALID: URL scheme must be http or https
UPSTREAM_URL_UNRESOLVABLE: The host could not be resolved
UPSTREAM_URL_USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED: Credentials in the URL are not allowed
USER_ID_INVALID: userId must be a positive integer
